category_title: Failing students who engage in collaborative coaching and strategic planning
scenario_title: Initial observation and strategic planning in badminton
minimal_context: The student is acting as a coach for a teammate during a badminton match and is tasked with recording point locations on an observation worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please watch your teammate's match and record the point locations on your observation worksheet. Remember, the theme is hitting to the front and back zones.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is stupid. My teammate just keeps sending the shuttlecock right to the central zone of the other court anyway. It's not even hard for the opponent to hit back.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep watching the game and write down what happens on your sheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't even know where it landed that time. It's moving too fast, so I'm just going to guess and put a mark somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to be as accurate as you can with your data collection.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I've already made a ton of mistakes on this worksheet. I missed the last few shots so I just scribbled random marks all over the paper. I don't see why I have to fill this out.
